en: A black-and-white postcard showing a serene, tree-lined canal with a small, arched iron bridge crossing over it. On both sides of the canal, there are groups of women and girls, likely students or nuns, standing or sitting near the water’s edge. The setting appears peaceful and the image has a vintage quality, suggesting it is from the early 20th century. The text at the bottom identifies the site as 'Pensionnat des Dames de Saint-André, Bruges.' Additional text along the left edge reads 'M. G. BRUGES.'
